blocks.text: Enhance your personal and professional productivity with a 16-inch laptop with a sleek, durable aluminum design.

items.label: Edge-to-edge clarity
items.value: Enjoy crisp, expansive visuals on a 16-inch 2K display and a 16:10 aspect ratio—delivering a wide, immersive viewing experience.

items.label: All-day comfort
items.value: Dell ComfortView helps reduce harmful blue light emissions, keeping your eyes comfortable—even during extended screen time.

items.label: Built for virtual connection
items.value: Bring your connections to life with an RGB FHD camera, designed with wide dynamic range and temporal noise reduction to deliver crisp, sharp images, no matter the lighting conditions.

items.label: Keyboard
items.value: Full size keyboard with number pad for ease of use and enhanced productivity with a carbon black backlit english keyboard including fingerprint reader.

items.label: Adaptive thermals
items.value: Built-in technology allows your PC to sense when it's on a stable surface and adjusts its power and thermals to run more efficiently.

items.label: Other Special Features of the Product
items.value: Anti Glare Coating, Backlit Keyboard, Fingerprint Reader, Memory Card Slot, Numeric Keypad

items.label: Compatible Devices
items.value: External displays, mice, keyboards, storage devices, printers, and other accessories with HDMI, USB, SD card, Bluetooth, or Wi-Fi connectivity
